name: Notion
summary: A workspace for documents, wikis, databases and projects, with Notion AI. Enterprise Search, a feature of Notion AI on the Business and Enterprise plans, answers questions from the workspace and connected apps (Slack, Google Drive, Jira and others) and cites its sources. For agents it publishes a hosted MCP server (search, read, create and update content, pages and databases) that connects to a Notion workspace by OAuth, or (documented 2026-10-26, Business and Enterprise plans) by an MCP token a workspace owner creates; measured 401 with an OAuth challenge and no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-23 keyless: MCP initialize at mcp.notion.com/mcp answers 401 with an OAuth challenge, one scope named default, plain PKCE. Docs read 2026-10-26: a workspace owner on Business or Enterprise can create an MCP token sent as a bearer, no browser sign-in; not measured here.

jobs.summary: Enterprise Search, the vendor's words: "finds answers to your questions in just seconds, searching your workspace and your connected apps" and "always cite its sources". Business and Enterprise plans, in the Notion app; whether the MCP surface reaches it is not established. Not measured.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-23: no surface prices a call or speaks a 402. The pricing page prices agent work in the vendor's words, 'Free to try, then $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits' for Custom Agents, and answers 'We currently accept all major credit and debit card brands'. Who buys credits was not read.
